name: command-dispatch-and-help
body: The dispatch and help surface: `cmd_node`/`cmd_edge` route `add|update|rm`; `cmd_plan` routes `add|update|rm|done|undone|note|complete|render|verify`; `main` (`print_help`) documents the new surface and drops `plan init`/`plan link`. Uses the existing `plan apply`→`verify` rename message as-is.
